paper_title: First results of the CERN Resonant WISP Search (CROWS)
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing parameter chi (dimensionless), exactly as plotted on the y-axis
notes: CROWS is a microwave light-shining-through-wall experiment at CERN reporting first results (2013). It sets limits on BOTH axion-like particles (g = 4.5e-8 GeV^-1 at m_a = 7.2 ueV, wideband g = 9.9e-8 GeV^-1, June 2013 run in 3T magnet) AND hidden sector photons (chi = 4.1e-9 at m_gamma' = 10.8 ueV, September 2013 run). Following the pre-analysis hint, the DarkPhoton (HSP) result is extracted here, which is the result probing previously unexplored parameter space. Only the single most-sensitive point is quoted numerically in the text; the full exclusion curves are shown in Fig. 13/14 without tabulated data. Not a dark-matter haloscope (LSW technique), so no local DM density is assumed. Confidence reduced because the paper constrains two coupling types and only one text-quoted data point is available; the ALP limit (AxionPhoton, [[7.2e-6, 4.5e-8]]) could be extracted as a separate entry. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.6, 36)) | Vision: FIG. 14 of Betz et al. (CROWS, PRD 88, 075014), September 2013 run, 95% CL. Boundary anchored to the printed best-limit annotation (m=10.8 ueV, chi=4.1e-9). Low-mass branch follows the expected chi ~ (f_sys/m)^2 scaling (fit slope ~ -2.25 to the visible blue band extending toward the top-left corner; parts of the CROWS region are overlaid by ADMX-LSW/UWA-LSW/ALPS gray regions, so intermediate points are model-interpolated). High-mass branch (evanescent regime, m > 2pi f_sys) traced visually with slope ~ +2.5 to +3, terminating near 1.5e-4 eV where the blue region merges with other bounds. This is an LSW experiment: no dark-matter density assumption. Coupling type unambiguous (hidden sector photon kinetic mixing); moderate confidence reflects the approximate visual/model tracing rather than tabulated data.
